Vista Charter Public Schools

We Transform
the School
Experience

At Vista Charter Public Schools, we are committed to transforming the school experience. From the moment you walk into a Vista Charter Public school you will notice the difference. Beyond the warm welcome and inviting environment is a team of highly trained teachers, administrators, and support personnel, all of whom share the goal of ensuring that our students are highly engaged in their academic life and feel 100% accepted as part of the Vista family.

Collin Felch, Ed.D., Superintendent

Practices

The heart of a transformative educational school experience is not in the promise of a silver bullet solution, but in profound and sustainable pedagogical change. At Vista Charter Public Schools, we do not believe programs are the answer to transformative education, but carefully chosen programs can serve as foundational learning labs where teachers acquire the tools and strategies that, when mastered, will create the conditions for creative and academic freedom.

pages.title: Admission
pages.content:
Academics & Research

Admission

How to Join Vista

Vista Charter Public Schools is a tuition-free public charter network open to all students. Here's how the admission process works, from application to your first day.

1

Submit Application

Complete our Online Application Form during the enrollment window for the grade you're applying to.

2

Schedule a Tour

Visit campus and see our classrooms, teachers, and programs in action before deciding.

3

Lottery / Review

If applications exceed available seats, students are entered into a fair, public lottery process.

4

Check Your Result

Use our Admission Result page to check your status once decisions are released.

5

Enrollment

Accepted families complete enrollment paperwork to officially secure their spot at Vista.

pages.title: Agentic Learning
pages.content:
Facilities & Services

Agentic Learning

Powered by Akoro AI

Agentic Learning — Powered by Akoro

Vista Charter Public Schools has partnered with Akoro to bring AI-powered adaptive learning agents into every classroom. Each student is paired with a personal AI learning agent that adapts to their pace, learning style, and interests.

Through guided teaching sessions, students explain concepts back to their agent — reinforcing mastery while building the confidence and communication skills that come from truly understanding a topic well enough to teach it.

How It Works

  • Students teach their AI agent a concept in a guided session
  • The agent asks clarifying questions to check real understanding
  • An assessment gate confirms mastery before advancing to the next topic
  • Progress and confidence scores sync directly with teacher dashboards
  • Voice and text interaction available to fit each learner's preference

"Agentic learning has changed how my daughter approaches homework — she's not just memorizing, she's explaining, questioning, and truly owning what she learns."

— Vista Parent

Clubs & Culture

Beyond the classroom, Vista students explore their passions through a wide range of clubs, teams, and cultural programs. We believe well-rounded students thrive — and every club is a chance to build community, confidence, and new skills.

Basketball

Visual Arts

Debate Team

pages.title: FAQ
pages.content:
Frequently Asked Questions

What grades does Vista serve?
Vista Charter Public Schools serves students from Junior Secondary (grades 6-8) through Senior Secondary (grades 9-12) across our network of campuses.
Is there a tuition fee?
No. As a public charter school network, Vista is completely tuition-free and open to all students regardless of background, income, or ability.
How do I apply?
Complete our Online Application Form during the enrollment window. If applications exceed available capacity, students are entered into a fair, public lottery process.
What is Agentic Learning?
Our Akoro-powered AI learning agents help students reinforce mastery by teaching concepts back to a personal AI tutor, building deeper understanding and confidence.
Is transportation provided?
Bus routes are available for select areas. Contact your campus office directly for current route information and eligibility.
Do you offer summer programs?
Yes! Our six-week summer program is open to all Vista students and blends academic enrichment with art, science, sports, and outdoor adventure.

Academics & Research

Junior Secondary Academy

Grades 6-8

Vista Junior Secondary Academy

Grades 6-8. Our Junior Secondary program bridges elementary foundations with the academic rigor of secondary education. Students explore STEM, humanities, and the arts while developing critical thinking, collaboration, and self-advocacy skills.

Advisory groups and dedicated social-emotional learning time ensure every student feels supported through this pivotal transition — academically, socially, and emotionally.

Academic Highlights

  • Core subjects taught by grade-level specialist teachers
  • STEAM electives including robotics and design
  • Daily advisory period for mentorship and check-ins
  • Athletics program beginning in 6th grade

Library

Vista Libraries

Each Vista campus features a well-stocked library supporting literacy development and independent inquiry. Our collections span fiction, non-fiction, bilingual titles, and digital resources that reflect the diverse experiences of our students.

Librarians partner with classroom teachers to integrate research skills and a love of reading into every subject — from science research projects to historical fiction book clubs.

Library Services

  • Open access during school hours and after-school programs
  • Bilingual and multicultural book collections
  • Digital catalog and e-book access for all students
  • Weekly story time for Primary School students

pages.content:
Facilities & Services

Live Classes

Live Classes

Vista offers live-streamed classes for students who need flexible attendance options — including illness recovery, family travel, or independent study days. Live classes mirror our in-person curriculum in real time, taught by the same teachers students see every day.

Students join through a secure link shared by their homeroom teacher and can participate fully, asking questions and completing classwork alongside their in-person classmates.

pages.title: Mission & Vision
pages.content:
About

Mission & Vision

Our Mission

Vista Charter Public Schools exists to transform the school experience for every student we serve. We believe that profound, sustainable pedagogical change — not silver-bullet programs — is what creates lasting academic and personal growth.

From the moment a family walks through our doors, they notice the difference: a warm welcome, an inviting environment, and a team of highly trained teachers, administrators, and support staff who share one goal — ensuring every student is engaged, challenged, and 100% accepted as part of the Vista family.

What Drives Us

  • Every child has a right to a free, high-quality public education
  • Our doors are open to all students, regardless of background
  • We prioritize learning and belonging above all else
  • Teachers are equipped with the tools to create academic and creative freedom

Our Vision

We envision a network of schools where every student — regardless of zip code, income, or background — has equal access to a transformative education. Where teachers are empowered with research-backed tools and strategies, not one-size-fits-all programs, to meet each learner exactly where they are.

We envision classrooms where curiosity is celebrated, mistakes are part of the process, and every student graduates ready for the next chapter — whether that's high school, college, or a career they're proud of.

"At Vista Charter Public Schools, we do not believe programs are the answer to transformative education — but carefully chosen tools can serve as foundational learning labs where teachers acquire the strategies that create the conditions for creative and academic freedom."

— Collin Felch, Ed.D., Superintendent

pages.title: Partnerships
pages.content:
About

Partnerships

Our Community Partners

Vista Charter Public Schools collaborates with mission-aligned organizations to expand opportunities for our students — from nutrition and wellness to enrichment, technology, and college readiness.

These partnerships allow us to offer resources far beyond what a single school district could provide alone, strengthening the safety net around every Vista family.

Revolution Foods

Providing fresh, chef-crafted meals to students across all Vista campuses every school day.

Community Health Partners

Wellness programs, vision and dental screenings, and mental health resources for students and families.

College Access Network

Guidance counseling, application support, and scholarship resources for Senior Secondary students.

Akoro

AI-powered adaptive learning agents bringing personalized, agentic education to every Vista classroom.

Become a Partner

Are you a business or organization interested in supporting Vista students? We welcome partnerships in mentorship, internships, in-kind donations, and community events. Reach out through our Contact Us page to start the conversation.

pages.title: Primary School
pages.content:
Academics & Research

Primary School

Building Strong Foundations

Our Primary School program builds the foundation for a lifetime of learning. Through play-based and hands-on instruction, young students develop literacy, numeracy, and social-emotional skills in a nurturing, joyful environment.

Small class sizes ensure every child receives individual attention as they take their first steps toward academic confidence — learning to read, count, question, and collaborate alongside classmates who quickly become friends.

What Makes Us Different

  • Play-based curriculum grounded in developmental research
  • Dedicated literacy and numeracy specialists
  • Daily outdoor exploration and movement
  • Social-emotional learning woven into every day

pages.content:
Academics & Research

Senior Secondary School

Grades 9-12

Vista Senior Secondary School

Grades 9-12. Our Senior Secondary program prepares students for college, career, and civic life. Rigorous coursework, elective pathways, and real-world projects challenge students to think independently and pursue their passions.

Dedicated college counseling and career readiness programs support every student's path after graduation — whether that means a four-year university, community college, trade school, or entering the workforce directly.

Pathways & Programs

  • AP and honors coursework across core subjects
  • Career technical education pathways
  • One-on-one college and career counseling
  • Internship and dual-enrollment opportunities

pages.content:
Facilities & Services

Summer Programs

Summer Programs

Open to all Vista students, our summer programs blend academic enrichment with fun — art, science, sports, and outdoor adventure. Programs run for six weeks each summer at select campuses, with both full-day and half-day options available.

Summer is also a great time for incoming students to get familiar with Vista before the school year begins — many of our summer participants start the fall semester already feeling at home.

pages.content:
About

Team & Staffs

The people behind Vista Charter Public Schools.

Leadership Team

Our leadership team brings decades of combined experience in education, operations, and community partnership — united by a shared commitment to putting students first.

Collin Felch, Ed.D.

Superintendent. Leads district-wide strategy, academic vision, and community partnerships across all Vista campuses.

Maria Gonzalez

Deputy Superintendent. Oversees daily operations, staff development, and cross-campus coordination.

James Okoye

Director of Academics. Designs curriculum standards and leads our academic assessment programs.

Sarah Kim

Director of Student Services. Champions social-emotional learning and student wellbeing initiatives.

David Torres

Business Operations Director. Manages finance, facilities, and district-wide resource planning.

Lisa Nguyen

Human Resources Director. Recruits and supports the exceptional educators who make Vista possible.

Join Our Team

We're always looking for passionate educators and staff who share our commitment to transformative education. Visit our Employment Opportunities page to see current openings across all Vista campuses.
